channel.title: Monterey County Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Monterey County Herald (montereyherald.com)

item.title: Monterey declares fiscal emergency to place tax measures on June ballot
item.description: The council voted unanimously to declare a fiscal emergency, which city officials said was needed in order to place new tax measures on the ballot. The council then voted to start the process of placing .375 cent tax measure on the ballot and plan on voting on a parking tax as well.

item.title: Judge weighs Washington Post’s demand for government to return devices seized from reporter’s home
item.description: U.S. Magistrate Judge William Porter didn’t rule from the bench Friday on the newspaper’s request.

item.title: US sets up gold-medal game against Canada at the Olympics by cruising past Slovakia
item.description: The much-anticipated U.S.-Canada showdown for gold in men’s hockey is on.

item.title: ‘Hotdog’ in the halfpipe! Alex Ferreira finally wins his Olympic gold
item.description: The 31-year-old Ferreira won with a third and final run worth 93.75 points.

item.title: US audit finds gaps in the FAA’s oversight of United Airlines maintenance
item.description: The FAA says it accepts most recommendations and has steps underway to address them.

item.title: Texas man was fatally shot by a federal immigration agent last year during a stop, new records show
item.description: The death of 23-year-old Ruben Ray Martinez occurred in March on South Padre Island.

item.title: Trump administration to stand by tough Biden-era mandates to replace lead pipes
item.description: There are millions of lead pipes serving homes, mostly in older industrial cities.

item.title: Trump seethes over Supreme Court justices who opposed him on tariffs, especially those he appointed
item.description: Legal opposition to the tariffs crossed political lines.

item.title: Justice Department swiftly fires lawyer chosen as top federal prosecutor for Virginia office
item.description: James Hundley was fired via social media Friday shortly after he was chosen by judges.

item.title: McGuire enters special election to serve out late Rep. LaMalfa’s unfinished term
item.description: With the race on late Rep. Doug LaMalfa’s former turf, rather than in the Democrat-friendly, post-Prop. 50 1st Congressional District, state Sen. Mike McGuire will be the underdog.
